definitions.ask: Should a second `-` on the alias-opened Links To picker restore a literal `--` rather than flip to `~~`?
definitions.why: The existing Tab em-dash gesture and CLI-flag text both begin with a spaced `--`.

choices.label: `--` stays literal, so `--` Tab em dashes and `--flag` text keep working
`--` becomes `~~` (Linked From) like `,,` → `++`; spaced `--` Tab em dashes need Undo

definitions.ask: Should Escape on the alias-opened picker, with an empty filter, restore the literal `-`?
definitions.why: The alias is a guess, and Escape is the natural way to reject it when a picker pops up mid-prose.

choices.label: One Escape closes the picker and leaves the typed `-`
Escape keeps `~` and shows the reopen chip like every other picker; Undo then restores `-`
